user_story:
As a user, I want to log into the secure area of the application so that I can access restricted content. Acceptance criteria: 
1. I can enter my username into the input field with id 'username'. 
2. I can enter my password into the input field with id 'password'. 
3. When I click the button with class 'radius' and text 'Login', I should be redirected to the appropriate page based on my credentials.
